text:
**Onboarding pilot (Marcus Hale): inconclusive. Don't roll out nationally yet.**

- **Test (Aug–Sep):** Sydney customers got a 45-minute guided onboarding call. Perth got email-only. The measure was the share still active after 30 days.
- **Headline:** Sydney 81% vs Perth 74%, an apparent 7-point lift.
- **Problem:** 60% of Sydney customers got a free first month, which inflates retention. Among paying customers only, the gap is 2 points (78% vs 76%), within normal variation.
- **Cost if rolled out:** ~$95 per session, ~$410,000/year nationally.
- **Note:** Sales' claim that the pilot "proved" guided onboarding works isn't supported.
- **Decision needed (21 October leadership meeting):** Approve a 60-day test randomly assigning customers within the same city, starting November.
